issues.description: Default turn_detection_mode flip from EXTERNAL to FIXED is a silent behavioral break.
issues.detail: All six reviewers flagged this. Existing callers who relied on the default get different endpointing semantics on upgrade with no code change. Changelog labels it as a 'fix' but it is a breaking default change. Either document loudly as a migration in the changelog/docstring, emit a transitional warning when the default is taken, or keep EXTERNAL as default.

issues.description: _enable_vad complects multiple concerns and lacks a stated invariant.
issues.detail: A single boolean derived from EndOfUtteranceMode now governs frame emission, external-finalize acceptance, and a warning branch, with a double-negative elif. The invariant ('true iff this plugin emits VAD/interruption frames') is unwritten and the name mismatches semantics. Decompose into named predicates (emits_vad_frames, accepts_external_finalize) or document the invariant explicitly at the class boundary.

issues.description: Frame-handler switch to VADUserStoppedSpeakingFrame narrows accepted frames without documenting the contract.
issues.detail: Finalization now only triggers on VAD-specific stop frames; UserStoppedSpeakingFrame is ignored. Non-VAD producers will silently lose finalization. The warning-then-do-nothing branch when _enable_vad is true conflates 'unexpected' with 'ignored.' Either route the frame at the dispatcher so this method only sees actionable frames, or document the stricter precondition at the supertype level.

issues.description: split_sentences uses tri-state Optional[bool] but is coerced with `or False`, collapsing None and False.
issues.detail: Declared `bool | None = None` then written as `params.split_sentences or False`, which defeats the optional and silently overwrites any vendor default in speech_segment_config. Either declare `bool = False` and pass through, or only set speech_segment_config when the user explicitly opted in. Pick a semantics for None and encode it.

issues.description: Commented-out start_processing_metrics line moved but not deleted or restored.
issues.detail: The `# await self.start_processing_metrics()` line was relocated within _handle_start_of_turn with no functional effect. Either uncomment it with a rationale for the new ordering, or delete it. Carrying dead commented code forward in a new position encodes an unresolved decision as noise.

issues.description: Docstrings for turn_detection_mode do not clearly define what FIXED vs EXTERNAL guarantee.
issues.detail: The class-level and InputParams docstrings were updated to mention FIXED as default but still contain framing that conflates 'Pipecat-controlled' across both modes. A reader cannot tell from the spec what guarantees each mode provides. Add a short contract paragraph per mode describing who owns endpointing and which frames drive finalization.

synthesis.summary: The panel converges on three structural concerns and three cleanup items. The headline issue, flagged unanimously, is the silent default flip from EXTERNAL to FIXED — a behavioral break mislabeled as a 'fix' that needs a real migration story. The _enable_vad boolean now complects multiple concerns (frame emission, external-finalize acceptance, warning behavior) without a stated invariant, and the switch to VADUserStoppedSpeakingFrame narrows the accepted frame contract without documentation. Cleanup items: split_sentences uses a tri-state Optional then collapses it with `or False`, a commented metrics call was relocated rather than resolved, and the mode docstrings don't actually define what FIXED vs EXTERNAL guarantee. Verdict: needs-work — document the contracts, decompose the predicate, and either justify or revert the default change.
